chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: Cousins on Danny's genealogy list: Clemons, Taphole, Arthadeaux, Perez
summary: Danny explains the list of relatives who played music: Octavia Clemons, Lydell Taphole, Charlie Lajoie, Howard Randolph, Arthur Arthadeaux, and Manuel Perez.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: He's a cousin of yours, huh?
He's a cousin of my grandmother's, Clemons. And the cousins of my grandmother also are the Taphole's(?).
Yeah, Lydell Taphole. He played banjo, huh?

Yeah, and his brother, Charlie Lajoie. He was a guitar player and a banjo player. Now, Howard Randolph(?) is a piano player. That's a brother-in-law for them. He married Taphole's(?) sister. Is Randolph(?) there?
Yeah, it's here. And there's Arthur...
Yeah. Sister. That name is still going, huh.

No, there are no more Arthadeaux. Louis was the youngest brother. And there was Arthur Arthadeaux. We used to call him Artur; Artur(?) in patois. A really fine looking man. They had sisters, and they've got some of them out in the country.
You have Manuel Perez. He was a great name. This is a great name trumpet player.
Paul Barbarin's godfather. You mentioned him a long time ago.
